device.modelDescription: R2-1 Task 3's callee: counts how often its handler ran, so a refused hop can be shown to have run nothing.

actionList.name: bump
actionList.description: Counts one run and returns the count.

actionList.name: count
actionList.description: Returns the count without changing it.

actionList.name: slow
actionList.description: Counts one run after input.ms milliseconds: a callee that answers after its caller's timeout.

actionList.name: tick
actionList.description: Counts one run, like bump; what a caller that declares only bump may not call.
